scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @azul/contracts build && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "pnpm --filter @azul/api dev" "pnpm --filter @azul/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @azul/contracts build && pnpm --filter @azul/api build && pnpm --filter @azul/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @azul/contracts build && pnpm --filter @azul/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @azul/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @azul/contracts build && pnpm --filter @azul/api test && pnpm --filter @azul/web test
